verses.geez: ይስዕመኒ፡ በስዕመተ፡ አፉሁ። አዳም፡ አጥባትኪ፡ እምወይን። ወመዐዛ፡ ዕፍረትኪ፡ እምኵሉ፡ አፈው።
verses.translation: The Song of songs, which is Solomon's.

translations.lxx: The Song of songs, which is Solomon's.
translations.kjv: The song of songs, which is Solomon’s.
translations.ron: Sărută-mă cu sărutările gurii tale, că sărutările tale sunt mai bune ca vinul.

verses.geez: ዕፍረት፡ ዘተሰውጠ፡ ስምከ። ወበእንተዝ፡ ደናግል፡ አፍቀራከ። ወሰሐባከ፡ ድኅሬከ።
verses.translation: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy breasts are better than wine.

translations.lxx: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy breasts are better than wine.
translations.kjv: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.
translations.ron: Miresmele tale sunt balsam mirositor, mir vărsat este numele tău; de aceea fecioarele te iubesc.

verses.geez: በመዐዛ፡ ዕፍረትከ፡ ንረውጽ። አብአኒ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽርሑ። ንትፈሣሕ፡ ወንትሐሠይ፡ ብኪ። ናፍቅር፡ አጥባተኪ፡ እምወይን። ወርቱዕ፡ አፍቅሮትኪ።
verses.translation: And the smell of thine ointments is better than all spices: thy name is ointment poured forth; therefore do the young maidens love thee.

translations.lxx: And the smell of thine ointments is better than all spices: thy name is ointment poured forth; therefore do the young maidens love thee.
translations.kjv: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
translations.ron: Răpeşte-mă, ia-mă cu tine! Hai să fugim! - Regele m-a dus în cămările sale: ne vom veseli şi ne vom bucura de tine. Îţi vom preamări dragostea mai mult decât vinul. Cine te iubeşte, după dreptate te iubeşte!

verses.geez: ጸላም፡ አነ፡ ወሠናይት፡ እምአዋልደ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም። ከመ፡ ምጽላላተ፡ ቄዳር፡ ወኀይመታተ፡ ሰሎሞን።
verses.translation: They have drawn thee: we will run after thee, for the smell of thine ointments: the king has brought me into his closet: let us rejoice and be glad in thee; we will love thy breasts more than wine: righteousness loves thee.

translations.lxx: They have drawn thee: we will run after thee, for the smell of thine ointments: the king has brought me into his closet: let us rejoice and be glad in thee; we will love thy breasts more than wine: righteousness loves thee.
translations.kjv: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
translations.ron: Neagră sunt, fete din Ierusalim, dar frumoasă, ca sălaşurile lui Chedar, ca şi corturile lui Solomon.

verses.geez: ኢትርአያኒ፡ እስመ፡ አነ፡ ጸላም። እስመ፡ ኢርእየኒ፡ ፀሓይ።
verses.translation: I am black, but beautiful, ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

translations.lxx: I am black, but beautiful, ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
translations.kjv: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
translations.ron: Nu vă uitaţi că sunt negricioasă că doar soarele m-a ars. Fiii maicii mele s-au mâniat, trimisu-m-au să le păzesc viile, dar via mea nu mi-am păzit-o!

verses.geez: ደቂቀ፡ እምየ፡ ተባአሱ፡ በእንቲኣየ። አንበሩኒ፡ ዐቃቢተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ወይን። ዐጸደ፡ ወይን፡ ዘዚኣየ፡ ኢዐቀብኩ።
verses.translation: Look not upon me, because I am dark, because the sun has looked unfavourably upon me: my mother's sons strove with me; they made me keeper in the vineyards; I have not kept my own vineyard.

translations.lxx: Look not upon me, because I am dark, because the sun has looked unfavourably upon me: my mother's sons strove with me; they made me keeper in the vineyards; I have not kept my own vineyard.
translations.kjv: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother’s children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.
translations.ron: Spune-mi dar, iubitul meu, unde-ţi paşti tu oile? Unde poposeşti tu la amiază? De ce oare să rătăcesc zadarnic pe la turmele tovarăşilor tăi?

verses.geez: ንግረኒ፡ ዘአፍቀረት፡ ነፍስየ። አይቴ፡ ትሬዒ፡ ወአይቴ፡ ትሰክብ፡ ጊዜ፡ ቀትር። ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ እንዘ፡ ኣንጌጊ፡ ውስተ፡ መራዕየ፡ ካልኣኒከ።
verses.translation: Tell me, thou whom my soul loves, where thou tendest thy flock, where thou causest them to rest at noon, lest I become as one that is veiled by the flocks of thy companions.

translations.lxx: Tell me, thou whom my soul loves, where thou tendest thy flock, where thou causest them to rest at noon, lest I become as one that is veiled by the flocks of thy companions.
translations.kjv: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?
translations.ron: Dacă nu ştii unde, tu cea mai frumoasă între femei, ţine atunci mereu urmele oilor, paşte-ti mieii în preajma colibelor, iezii în preajma ciobanilor!

verses.geez: እመ፡ ኢያእመርኪ፡ ርእሰኪ፡ ሠናይት፡ እምአንስት። ፃኢ፡ አንቲ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰኰናሆሙ፡ ለመርዔት። ወረዐዪ፡ መሓስዐ፡ አጣሊኪ። ውስተ፡ አዕጻዳቲሆሙ፡ ለኖሎት።
verses.translation: If thou know not thyself, thou fair one among women, go thou forth by the footsteps of the flocks, and feed thy kids by the shepherds' tents.

translations.lxx: If thou know not thyself, thou fair one among women, go thou forth by the footsteps of the flocks, and feed thy kids by the shepherds' tents.
translations.kjv: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds’ tents.
translations.ron: Cu un telegar înhămat la carul lui Faraon te aseamăn eu, draga mea!

verses.geez: ለፈረስየ፡ ወለሠረገላተ፡ ፈርዖን። አስተማሰልኩኪ፡ እንተ፡ ኀቤየ።
verses.translation: I have likened thee, my companion, to my horses in the chariots of Pharao.

translations.lxx: I have likened thee, my companion, to my horses in the chariots of Pharao.
translations.kjv: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh’s chariots.
translations.ron: Frumoşi se văd obrajii tăi, aşezaţi intre cercei şi gâtul tău împodobit cu şire de mărgăritare.

verses.geez: ጥቀ፡ አዳም፡ መላትሕኪ፡ ከመ፡ ማዕነቅ። ወክሣድኪ፡ ከመ፡ አርማስቆስ።
verses.translation: How are thy cheeks beautiful as those of a dove, thy neck as chains!

translations.lxx: How are thy cheeks beautiful as those of a dove, thy neck as chains!
translations.kjv: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.
translations.ron: Făuri-vom pentru tine lănţişoare aurite, cu picături şi crestături de argint.

verses.geez: አምሳለ፡ ወርቅ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ለኪ፡ ኰሰኰሰ፡ ዘብሩር። እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ያሰምክ፡ ቦቱ።
verses.translation: We will make thee figures of gold with studs of silver.

translations.lxx: We will make thee figures of gold with studs of silver.
translations.kjv: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
translations.ron: Cât regele a stat la masă, nardul meu a revărsat mireasmă.

verses.translation: So long as the king was at table, my spikenard gave forth its smell.

translations.lxx: So long as the king was at table, my spikenard gave forth its smell.
translations.kjv: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
translations.ron: Periniţă de mirt este iubitul meu, care se ascunde între sânii mei.

verses.geez: ዕቊረ፡ ማየ፡ ልብን፡ ዘወልድ፡ እኍየ፡ ሊተ። ማእከለ፡ አጥባትየ፡ የዐርፍ።
verses.translation: My kinsman is to me a bundle of myrrh; he shall lie between my breasts.

translations.lxx: My kinsman is to me a bundle of myrrh; he shall lie between my breasts.
translations.kjv: A bundle of myrrh is my well-beloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
translations.ron: Iubitul meu e ciorchinele de ienupăr, din Enghedi, de la vii cules.

verses.geez: አስካል፡ ዘጸገየ፡ ዘወልድ፡ እኍየ፡ ሊተ። ውስተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ወይን፡ ዘበጋዲ።
verses.translation: My kinsman is to me a cluster of camphor in the vineyards of Engaddi.

translations.lxx: My kinsman is to me a cluster of camphor in the vineyards of Engaddi.
translations.kjv: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of Engedi.
translations.ron: Cât de frumoasă eşti tu, draga mea! Cât de frumoasă eşti! Ochi de porumbiţă sunt ochii tăi.

verses.geez: ነያ፡ ሠናይት፡ እንተ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ነያ፡ ሠናይት። አዕይንትኪ፡ ዘርግብ።
verses.translation: Behold, thou art fair, my companion; behold, thou art fair; thine eyes are doves.

translations.lxx: Behold, thou art fair, my companion; behold, thou art fair; thine eyes are doves.
translations.kjv: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves’ eyes.
translations.ron: Cât de frumos eşti dragul meu! Şi cît de drăgălaş eşti tu! Pajiştea de iarbă verde ne este al nostru pat.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ሠናይ፡ አንተ፡ ወልድ፡ እኁየ። አዳም፡ በውስተ፡ ምስካቢነ፡ ዘበሕቊ።
verses.translation: Behold, thou art fair, my kinsman, yea, beautiful, overshadowing our bed.

translations.lxx: Behold, thou art fair, my kinsman, yea, beautiful, overshadowing our bed.
translations.kjv: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.
translations.ron: Cedrii ne sunt acoperiş sălăşluirii şi adăpost ne sunt chiparoşii.

verses.translation: The beams of our house are cedars, our ceilings are of cypress.

translations.lxx: The beams of our house are cedars, our ceilings are of cypress.
translations.kjv: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.

note: 'I am black and beautiful, O daughters of Jerusalem.' The Ethiopian church reads this with special affection — the beloved identifies herself as dark-skinned. The Song is read allegorically as the love between God and the church, or between Christ and the soul.
